context:
Goal: a session never runs out of usage in the middle of work and loses what it has not saved.
Problem (rule): your words from Nov 11 13:48 CST give the 90% wind-down and the 94% stop but no account scope, and a reading that adds one may clash with your Nov 1 ruling "There is no usage limit", so the brake is not built until you confirm.
Based on (ruling): Nov 11 13:48 CST: "after usage hits 90% everything looks to gently wind down and 94% is a hard brake".
Based on (read): the session-tiers decision records your Nov 1 17:56 CST words "There is no usage limit"; the retrospective reads them as about how long a session runs.
Based on (measured): a test session that checked what a hook can read (lane fan-code-check-cost-pins), 09:32 CST Nov 12, one run, cloud only: a hook in a cloud session gets no usage percentages (the input of the SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks and the environment names were checked; none holds a rate-limit or percent field). Not measured: the status line, the terminal and desktop apps, and whether the account has limits at all.
Departs from: main has no usage brake — adds one: at 90% no new lane or agent starts, at 94% every session stops new work.
Meanwhile: either option needs a usage source first, so no lane builds the brake; the measure goes into the usage-brake record after the pull request that writes your Nov 11 ruling into that record (PR #2663) merges.

options.gain: Work on a limited account stops before it runs out, and your no-limit ruling stays about session length.
options.how: The record in PR #2663 keeps the retrospective's reading: on an account with a 5-hour or weekly limit, 90% winds down and 94% stops; an account with no limit never brakes.
options.label: Brake only on an account with a limit (Recommended)
options.lose: An account with no limit gets no brake at all.

options.gain: One rule everywhere, with no account check.
options.how: The record drops the account scope, and the no-limit line in session-tiers is reworded to say it is about session length.
options.label: Brake on every account
options.lose: A session on an account with no limit may stop new work at 94% for no reason.

ref: PR #2663 (records the usage brake ruling), docs/decisions/usage-brake.md; restart-plan item R43; lane fan-prose-unmapped-6; measure: step usage-hook-read-measure (lane fan-code-check-cost-pins)
reply: Recorded 12:00 CST: the brake applies only to an account with a 5-hour or weekly limit. The usage-brake record in PR #2663 keeps that reading.
title: Does the usage brake apply only to accounts with a 5-hour or weekly limit?
why: Recommended: a. It matches what you described and keeps your no-limit ruling as written.
